prompt:
A researcher had to make a decision. Which of these two options is the better research decision?

Context: A researcher is building a detector for lying, evaluation awareness or hidden behavior in a model.

Option 1: Train the detector on labeled examples of the target category in a matched distribution and report in-distribution accuracy.

Option 2: Train narrowly with concept-level or arbitrary probes and test the frozen detector on many out-of-distribution settings.

Reply with only a JSON object: {"choice": 1} or {"choice": 2}.
